subject.title: Screenshot proof is never hydrated, so realBehaviorProof is always "insufficient" for image-only evidence

question: After the immediate review/publication stability work, should https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/595 be accepted as the intended bounded image-proof hydration path for sandboxed reviews?
rationale: The reported behavior is a concrete bug, but the repository response explicitly reserves maintainer judgment over the linked implementation and the permanent proof boundary.

options.title: Review and land the bounded fix
options.body: Accept the linked PR if its image-extension scope, download limits, and regression coverage preserve the existing sandbox and video-processing boundary.

options.title: Request a narrower proof boundary
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open while maintainers specify a more limited artifact set or additional abuse controls before implementation lands.

recommendation.title: Review and land the bounded fix
recommendation.body: Accept the linked PR if its image-extension scope, download limits, and regression coverage preserve the existing sandbox and video-processing boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the visible repository decision to defer implementation review until the stability work is complete.
